faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Common
faq.feedbackDesc: Your feedback shapes the future of self-custody. Share your thoughts, report issues, or suggest features.
faq.easterEgg: We're happy to hear from you.

q1.a: Hold the card to your phone's NFC sensor. The card communicates with your browser wallet, signs the transaction on-chip, and sends the signature back. Your private keys never leave the card.

q2.a: No. United Network works in any mobile browser via Web NFC. No app downloads required. We also offer companion apps on iOS and Android for users who prefer them.

q3.q: What happens if I lose my card?
q3.a: Your assets remain safe. Without your PIN, the card is useless to anyone who finds it. You can recover your wallet onto a new card using your backup phrase.

q4.a: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Arbitrum, Avalanche, BASE, Polygon, TON, Venom, BNB Smart Chain, Tron, and more. Plus over 20,000 tokens across these networks.

q5.a: Yes. Web3 projects can order custom-branded cards with their own design. We handle manufacturing, security, and logistics. Visit our Enterprise page for details.
